scale_cues: Used the white square dinner plate (approx. 26-28 cm across) as the scale reference. The salad mound spans roughly a third of the plate width and the rice mound about a third, consistent with a single adult entree portion. Did not see utensils or hands for a second scale reference.
assumptions: Plate is a standard 26-28 cm dinner plate, so the rice portion is about one cup cooked.
Brown rice is assumed plain, with no butter or oil visible.
Chickpea-like pieces could be roasted or seasoned chickpeas or another legume; identity is uncertain.
Dressing mass is estimated from the glossy sheen on the greens; the amount is hard to judge from overhead.
The white crumbles are assumed to be feta; they could be another soft white cheese.
Seeds are under 5 g and listed separately only because they are visible; they could be sesame or pumpkin seeds.
